cam1.headingNote: Pads about 2 m apart in a straight line; Black faces the next pad. It stops on the first pad different from the one it started on.
cam1.summary: Black: pad-01 -> straight ahead until the next mission pad (pad-02, max 4 m) -> centre over it -> Grok describe -> wait for voice command
cam1.describeQuestion: Briefly describe the scene from this indoor drone: people (clothes, colours), notable objects, and left/centre/right. Two short sentences.

path.note: skipped when Black is already flying (next person = next pad)
straight ahead until the downward sensor sees the next mission pad, then centre over it
Hover over the pad; wait for the next person or a voice command

steps.note: Hover at pad-01; wait for next voice command

safety.note: No takeoff unless the triggering slot is ARM ON. pad_hop stops at the first new pad or after maxCentimeters (then hovers). Restart disarms all slots. Voice UI (named pilot) claims and flies so return commands work.
